title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-mjcp: DEFAULT_RECEIVER_LIMIT undefined in fragmentation.rs tests
description:
## Issue

`rust/lichen-schc/tests/fragmentation.rs` imports `DEFAULT_RECEIVER_LIMIT` from `lichen_schc::fragment` (line 8), used 18 times as storage size and constructor argument. This constant is not defined anywhere in the `fragment` module or in the crate.

```rust
use lichen_schc::fragment::{
    ..., DEFAULT_RECEIVER_LIMIT, MAX_ACK_REQUESTS, TILE_SIZE,
};
```

## Impact

`cargo test -p lichen-schc --features std` fails with:
```
error[E0432]: unresolved import `lichen_schc::fragment::DEFAULT_RECEIVER_LIMIT`
```

This blocks all integration tests for SCHC fragmentation end-to-end.

## Fix

Either define `DEFAULT_RECEIVER_LIMIT` as a public constant (e.g., `pub const DEFAULT_RECEIVER_LIMIT: usize = 1500;` matching `SCHC_MAX_DECOMPRESSED`) or replace all usages with `SCHC_MAX_DECOMPRESSED`.
